metadata.title: That 1 kill Valorant handed me like ‘I wasn’t ready but here you go’
metadata.description:
Clicked once, kill happened.
Enemy probably uninstalling in disbelief.
Valorant logic: giving out surprise gifts like it’s a glitch day.
Click if your aim was on break but the game still hooked you up!

Tap if your aim ghosted but you still got the kill!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
